source_record.description:
Your missions

As a leading service provider in various industries, by Derichebourg Aeronautics we are building a team of unique talents to support one of our biggest partner in their production activities. In this regards, we are looking for Cabin Electricians for an exciting project in Hamburg.  By joining us, you will have the opportunity to work with our world-class team of leaders, experts and engineers who are as passionate about changing the world.

You will report directly to the respective Production Team Leader and work alongside our aircraft systems and final assembly production team: 

Your Responsibilities

  • Read and interpret technical drawings, work instructions and manufacturing documentation.
  • Troubleshoot electrical faults and replace electrical equipment on aircraft (e.g. lavatories, cabin linings and other interior components).
  • Troubleshoot and modify cable routing and electrical wiring harnesses on aircraft cabin interior components.
  • Carry out rework, repairs and modifications on aircraft and cabin interior products.
  • Identify the required fitting, adjustment and assembly steps for aircraft cabin components.
  • Shape, fit and adjust components, ensuring they meet the required specifications and quality standards.
  • Inspect completed work to ensure compliance with technical drawings and applicable quality requirements.


Your profile

  • Completed vocational training in aircraft maintenance, aircraft structural assembly, aircraft electrical systems, composite materials or a comparable technical field (e.g. Fluggerätmechaniker, Fluggerätelektroniker or an equivalent qualification).
  • Initial professional experience in composite material repair or aircraft cabin electrical systems, ideally combining both skill sets.
  • Experience in aircraft cabin interior fitting and adjustment (Flugzeugkabineninnenausbau / Kabinenmontage) is an advantage.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and manufacturing documentation.
  • Good English skills are an advantage.
  • Knowledge of SAP is a plus.
  • A structured, quality-oriented and hands-on approach to work.


Why join Derichebourg?

Elevate your career in a diverse and inclusive setting that celebrates differences. Join us and experience:

  1. Positive Work Environment: Immerse yourself in a good and pleasant atmosphere that values diversity, fostering creativity and collaboration.

  2. Dynamic Team Culture: Be part of a motivated and cooperative team that thrives on the strength of its multicultural dynamics, making every day a unique and enriching experience.

  3. Seamless Integration: Our welcoming integration process ensures you feel at home from day one, embracing the richness of diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

  4. HVV Proficard Contribution: Enjoy the convenience of a contribution towards your HVV Proficard, making your daily commute hassle-free in our vibrant, multicultural city.

  5. Personal Development Support: Experience active promotion of your personal and professional growth in an environment where global perspectives open doors to new horizons.

  6. Generous Time Off: Revel in 28 days of holidays per year and a flexible working time account, allowing you to appreciate cultural holidays and festivals that matter to you.

  7. Financial Security: Secure your future with a company retirement savings plan, ensuring peace of mind as you plan for the years ahead in our globally minded organization.

  8. Fitness Perks: We care about your well-being! Benefit from our contribution to your gym membership fees, promoting a healthy and active lifestyle in our multicultural community.

  9. Corporate Benefits: Unlock exclusive perks and discounts through our participation in the "Corporate Benefits" programme, enhancing your experience in a workplace that celebrates global perspectives.
Join us, where your career journey is complemented by a vibrant and supportive multicultural environment. Your success knows no boundaries! 


Apply now and embrace a future full of opportunities on a global scale.
